articles.title: Nick Blakey vows to win back trust after trade to Kangaroos in wake of Sydney Swans scandal
articles.summary: Blakey offloaded to North Melbourne in exchange for a glut of picks. Player had requested move after relationship with club fractured. Nick Blakey, one of five Sydney players embroiled in the Pullman Hotel scandal, has been granted his wish to join North Melbourne with a blockbuster trade.
body: The Kangaroos shipped picks No 6 and No 47, a 2027 second-round pick, a 2028 first-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick to get the deal done on Tuesday.

Blakey had five years remaining on his Swans deal but requested a trade following a fracturing of his relationship with the club. The 26-year-old star met with Geelong, St Kilda and Gold Coast but had his head turned by North’s reported eight-year offer worth more than $11m.

Blakey acknowledged the circumstances which led to him missing Sydney’s finals series, which eventually led to him leaving the club. He, along with four other players, were stood down by the Swans for breaching club standards after a post-AFL match party in East Melbourne.
Those suspensions are separate from an ongoing police investigation into an alleged sexual assault at the hotel.

articles.title: Brewers two wins from first World Series since 1982 as Contreras skewers Dodgers
articles.summary: NLCS Game 2: LA Dodgers 4-7 Milwaukee Brewers. Reigning champions 2-0 down in best-of-seven series. Guardians take Game 1 of ALCS against Rays. William Contreras hit a tying homer in the fifth and singled home the go-ahead run an inning later as the Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Los Angeles…
body: Four relievers combined to retire the last 15 Dodgers batters in order as the Brewers took a 2-0 lead over the two-time defending World Series champions in this best-of-seven series, which heads to Los Angeles for Game 3 on Wednesday.

The Brewers are chasing their second pennant and first in the NL. They made their lone World Series appearance in 1982, when they were in the American League. Los Angeles are trying to become the first NL team to win three straight World Series.

The Dodgers last rallied from a 2-0 deficit to win a series in 2020, when they beat the Atlanta Braves in a seven-game NLCS before going on to win the World Series. The Dodgers will need more punch from their lineup to have a chance at getting back to the Fall Classic. They mustered just three hits on Monday and went 0 for 4 with runners in scoring position to drop to 2 for 26 in those situations this postseason.

articles.title: Wales given play-off history lesson before Albania
articles.summary: Wales take a 1-0 lead into their play-off semi-final second leg against Albania as they chase a place at next year's tournament in Brazil.
body: Captain Angharad James has revealed Wales' players have been given a play-off history lesson as they bid to take another step towards a first Women's World Cup.
James has experienced the joy of play-off success and the pain of losing out at this stage of qualifying.
And the 32-year-old says Wales have moved to ensure every member of a squad featuring numerous youngsters is "up to speed" on what is at stake.

"We had a players' meeting on the first day just to integrate the group and to make sure everyone was aware of the importance of this camp and what it means to represent Wales and what it means to be in a play-off position.

articles.title: Ronaldo’s Asian Champions League match delayed by missile alert in Riyadh
articles.summary: Kick-off put back by an hour after attack intercepted. Portuguese forward scores in Al-Nassr’s 3-1 victory. Cristiano Ronaldo’s Al-Nassr had their Asian Champions League match delayed by an hour on Monday after the Saudi-led military coalition said it had intercepted a missile fired by the Houthis…
body: Saudi Arabia has recently come under a series of attacks from the Iran-backed group, with strikes on oil facilities, tankers and transport hubs – including a string of lethal hits on Riyadh’s international airport.
There was a sparse crowd in the stands of Alawwal Park for the game against Uzbekistan’s Neftchi Fergana, which was scheduled for kick-off at 9.15pm local time.

The stadium announcer said the situation was safe, that the match would be played, and asked spectators to remain in their seats. However, the television channel broadcasting the match announced a one-hour delay.

Shortly before the sound of explosions was reported in Riyadh. At the same time, Riyadh residents received an alert on their phones stating: “The region is exposed to a hostile aerial threat. Please remain calm and stay at home or in a safe place, away from windows and doors, and continue to follow civil defence instructions.”

articles.title: Coventry land long-awaited home win as Mfuni seals rout of Newcastle
articles.summary: If ever validation is needed for attack being the best form of defence, Frank Lampard can call this game up on Wyscout. Coventry climbed out of the relegation zone to the heady heights of 14th place after their second successive win showcased the benefits of their manager’s willingness to balance…
body: Jack Rudoni’s early penalty underscored a sense of positivity that was enhanced by an even quicker goal at the start of the second half from Sidiki Cherif and not unduly dimmed by Sven Botman’s howitzer making it 2-1.

Late goals from the substitutes Ellis Simms and Stephen Mfuni allowed promoted Coventry to pull away from a Newcastle side who, after a strong start to the season, also lost their last away game at Leeds by this scoreline.

Newcastle could have gone fourth in the Premier League with victory but despite missing several chances they could not argue with the defeat. As their manager, Matthias Jaissle, said: “There were elements in both boxes where we need to step up and do better. Those fine margins can make all the difference.”

Even when Botman had reduced the deficit with 20 minutes remaining and Newcastle threatened to take charge, Coventry left two or three players up on the halfway line. It could be perceived as a bold and brave move and Lampard, who wants supporters to be entertained throughout this first season back in the elite since 2000/01, deserves credit. On other days they might come unstuck but here it was a case of he who dares wins.

articles.title: Rams lose OT thriller vs. Bills, 37-34: Instant analysis of LA's loss
articles.summary: The first half made this game look like it wasn't going to be the high-scoring shootout that everyone expected, but the Los Angeles Rams and Buffalo Bills played the best game of 2026 so far.
body: The Rams moved the ball with ease from the start, but their opening drive came up empty due to a missed field goal, so they didn't get on the board until 8 minutes were left in the second quarter. That gave them their first lead, but the Bills answered back less than 3 minutes later to reclaim the edge on the scoreboard.

In the second half, they continued to trade touchdowns, each team scoring once in the third quarter and once in the first five minutes of the fourth quarter. Buffalo led 27-20 with 11:28 remaining, but once again, the Rams answered by scoring a touchdown 5 minutes later to tie it up, 27-27.

It was a game that felt like whichever team had the ball last would win, as both defenses struggled to get the necessary stops. The Bills scored the go-ahead touchdown with 1:39 left in the fourth quarter, but that left plenty of time for Matthew Stafford and the Rams to respond. And that they did. The Rams marched down the field in a minute and 34 seconds, tying it up at 34 with 5 seconds remaining and sending the game to overtime.

“I feel like that that’s a spot that you should be able to feel safe to talk to your team and communicate with your team. And, I mean, it’s happened before to us,” Smart added.

articles.title: Coventry thump Newcastle for first home win to move out of drop zone
articles.summary: Coventry made it back-to-back Premier League wins with a thumping 4-1 home victory over Newcastle to move Frank Lampard's side out of the relegation zone.
body: Goals from Jack Rudoni, teenager Sidiki Cherif and substitutes Ellis Simms and Stephen Mfuni gave the Sky Blues their first home win of the season.

A stunning Sven Botman strike had given Newcastle hope of a comeback in the 70th minute, but Simms restored the hosts' two-goal lead with his first touch 11 minutes later before Mfuni superbly added a fourth to become Coventry's youngest-ever Premier League goalscorer.

The visitors, who suffered a second consecutive 4-1 away defeat, made a nightmare start at the CBS Arena as goalkeeper Lukas Hornicek brought down summer signing Cherif to allow Rudoni to hit a sixth-minute penalty opener.
Newcastle responded well to falling behind but were wasteful as Matias Fernandez-Pardo missed two big chances, with his one-on-one opportunity cleared off the line by Bobby Thomas.

articles.title: Suljovic apologises but faces probe over inciting jeers and alleged sexist comments
articles.summary: Mensur Suljovic's crowd incitement during his match against Ross Smith and his alleged sexist comments in his on-stage interview regarding the incident have been referred to the Darts Regulation Authority.
body: The Austrian encouraged the crowd to boo the Englishman during a last-leg decider in their third-round clash at the Swiss Darts Trophy on Sunday afternoon.
He was later asked about the incident in an on-stage interview and used an allegedly sexist comment to describe how Smith reacted.
Suljovic said: "Ross Smith is one of the best players in the world - what's the bloke complaining about? He's got to play his game; otherwise, he's welcome to go home.
"Women, women - they're always complaining, sorry. Sorry, you don't do that. I fully accept him as one of the very best darts players.
